text:
sam: Quick sync — I'm starting a short migration handshake for the v2 endpoints. Goal: get owner matrix + blockers by EOD Friday so we can freeze the deprecation timeline.

jess: +1. can we list the API surfaces that need explicit compatibility shims?

sam: Good call. Off the top: /generate (streaming changes), /chat (sys role delta), /embeddings (shape/normalization), SDK clients (py/js), and webhook payloads.

maria: I can own /chat compatibility. I'll validate role handling and add a feature flag for legacy_mode.

alex: I can take SDK updates (js). Plan: bump client -> add adapter that maps old params to new ones, publish beta. Need a CI job to smoke test across node versions.

chris: I'll pick up /generate streaming behavior — specifically the chunk framing change. Need help on the runtime side to ensure old clients don't get truncated events. @sam can you loop in eng-runtime?

sam: Yep, will ping runtime. DeployBot: scheduled canary window for v2 SDK beta next Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.

DeployBot: Canary job created: job/eng-releases/v2-sdk-beta-canary (status: scheduled)

jess: For embedding normalization, @maria do you want a quick spec doc? Might be good to lock math before SDK changes.

maria: Yes — I'll drop a PR with a spec and small test vectors by tomorrow.

alex: SDK PRs: i) adapter ii) update docs iii) e2e smoke tests. Will tag reviewers: @jess, @chris. ETA: Wed for PRs, Thu for fixes.

chris: Runtime folks — if you can add a compatibility-mode flag that preserves old SSE framing for 48 hours after rollout, that buys us time for SDK propagation. Is that feasible?

sam: Runtime said they'd attempt a short-lived compatibility toggle. @chris please open a runtime ticket with exact framing details.

jess: Dependency check: docs team needs final API diffs by Thu to update migration guide. @alex @maria can you coordinate so docs have accurate examples?

maria: I'll coordinate — will include before/after snippets.

alex: Adding note — we should increment minor version, but NOT break the telemetry tags (so cost analytics stay intact). Will add to PR checklist.

triage-bot: Reminder: file migration tickets for each customer-facing change to surface to CS and account teams.

sam: Action items summary:
- maria -> /chat spec + tests (due Thu EOD)
- alex -> js SDK adapter + PRs (due Wed/Thu)
- chris -> runtime ticket & streaming compat flag (open today)
- jess -> embedding spec coordination + docs liaison
- sam -> coordinate runtime & CS notification schedule

sam: If anyone has blockers (org, infra, or legal) call them out here. Otherwise I'll mark these owners in the migration board and ping infra for the canary window slot. :thumbsup:

jess: No blockers from infra perspective. small ask: can we get a dedicated canary VM for SDK smoke tests?

sam: I'll ask infra.

maria: One minor blocker — we need clarity on whether old role names must be accepted indefinitely or can be remapped with warning headers. Legal prefers mapping + explicit deprecation header. Will follow up.

sam: Ok noted. We'll default to mapping + X-Deprecation-Warning header for a 90-day window. Update board when confirmed.

alex: I'll add telemetry to SDK beta to detect old param usage so we can measure migration progress.

chris: runtime ticket opened: RUNTIME-4532 — includes framing spec and compat flag request. Assigned to @runtime-ops.

sam: Great. I'll update the migration board and create tickets for any missing pieces. If you don't get an assignment, ping me. Thanks all.

jess: Thanks — will subscribe docs and support threads.

maria: Subscribed.

alex: Subscribed + starting PRs now.

DeployBot: job/eng-releases/v2-sdk-beta-canary scheduled for 2025-04-22T09:00:00Z

sam: Closing the handshake session here. We'll reconvene if any new blockers surface.
